name: K-Way
verdict: A brand of BasicNet S.p.A., the Italian group listed on Borsa Italiana that also owns Kappa. Nothing found.
note: Official supplier of the DS Automobiles SailGP Team France (k-challenge.fr SailGP page, opened 2026-10-02). Rating note: none. The ownership claim names BasicNet S.p.A. as K-Way's owner (k-way-basicnet-ownership); BasicNet is an Italian listed company led by the Boglione family, and in October 2024 Permira announced an agreement to acquire a significant minority stake in K-Way from BasicNet.
